description: Pick the slopped.site thing of the day: an artwork, a game, a codex entry, a clock or a song, the day’s SK8 2026 skate level, or the day’s twelve ideas (machine-made prompts for new slop from ideas.slopped.site, to make or vote on). The same pick for everyone on a given date (UTC); seasonal pieces only in their season. Use when someone wants one recommendation or a daily pick. Returns its id, name, link and a line about it.

kind.description: What kind of thing to pick. sk8 is the skate game’s daily level (a seed and a link); idea is all twelve of the day’s ideas, each a prompt with its id and link.
